name: app tasks not loading in mobile
description:
1. Investigated why "tasks" fails to load on mobile in codx-junior-ui, tracing the mobile rendering path through `App.vue`'s `RouterView`.
2. Found the mobile bottom bar correctly routes via `$navigation.apps.openKanban()`, but the sidebar's `AppsSection.vue` used the desktop-only `$ui.setActiveTab('tasks')`.
3. `setActiveTab` only adds a dockview panel rendered by desktop `Desktop.vue`, so on mobile no route change occurs and nothing renders.
4. Fix: replaced `setActiveTab('tasks')` with `$navigation.apps.openKanban()` in `handleNavigateToKanban`, which handles both desktop (`showTab`) and router/mobile (`push /kanban`).
5. Flagged sibling handlers (`Messenger`, `File Explorer`, `Wiki`, plus `MainMenu`/`QuickBar`/`TabNavigation`) as optional follow-ups sharing the same mobile limitation.
